infoPlist.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Afterglow reads which artists are in your Apple Music library to learn the sounds you love. Nothing about your library is shared.

plugins.photosPermission: Afterglow opens your videos so you can keep festival moments in Memories.
plugins.cameraPermission: Afterglow uses the camera to record festival moments for your Memories.
plugins.microphonePermission: Afterglow records sound with your festival videos.

plugins.photosPermission: Afterglow reads when and where a video was filmed to guess who was playing.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Afterglow saves your memories to Photos when you ask.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Afterglow uses where you are to show festivals near you and, when you record, to work out which festival you're at.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Afterglow can keep a trail of where you walk on festival days, only if you turn it on. It stays on your phone and stops when the festival is over.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Afterglow can keep a trail of where you walk on festival days, only if you turn it on. It stays on your phone and stops when the festival is over.

plugins.calendarPermission: Afterglow adds the festivals you're going to to your calendar.
plugins.writeOnlyCalendarPermission: Afterglow adds the festivals you're going to to your calendar.

plugins.cameraPermission: Afterglow uses the camera to record festival moments for your Memories.
plugins.microphonePermission: Afterglow records sound with your festival videos.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Afterglow uses Face ID to keep your Look after yourself notes private.

plugins.motionPermission: Afterglow counts your steps on a festival night in Look after yourself. Your steps stay on this phone.
